title: Read-only gameplay state for timed Crowd Control rewards

slots.463: Root-owned freshness timestamp; module does not publish it

integration.position: Include after WorldFeatures.inl and PlayerRoleSupport.inl. Call once per post-update snapshot on the engine thread with fresh TrainerContext.
integration.publication: Root publishes463 within the same seqlock. Core rejects missing/inconsistent values or age>1000ms.
integration.semantics: Known means the observer recognized the current native state; IsControllable means the supported current role passed all documented control gates and no blocker remains.
integration.self_pause: Trainer-owned field pause requires Held+globalsOwned+same scene+field2+capture1+own timer bit. Trainer actor freeze requires World ownership+same scene+global freezebit. Simultaneous external blockers are never removed.
integration.ownership: Observation does not modify native memory, World ownership, gameplay settings or save data.

limitations: Static analysis and synthetic tests only; no live injection/UI/gameplay tests were performed.
The role dependency is tested in the separate PlayerRole/Drive suite. The dedicated gameplay matrix stubs only that dependency and World ownership.
Recognized native event presence is conservatively considered a Cutscene blocker, including interactive event modes.
Arbitrary modded code/vtables or unrecognized controller replacements return Unknown. The current build and original executable hash are the support boundary.
Concurrent third-party writes can occur between observations. Fresh on-engine-thread reads and SEH fail-closed handling do not claim a lock against arbitrary foreign threads.
No blanket assertion that AC183C camera bank or2A0D628 background resource request means cutscene/loading; neither is used for that classification.
Native timer-owner values alone do not prove player control availability; foreign owners conservatively keep Unknown.
Trainer bit ownership inherits the existing WorldFeatures scene binding and has no native generation token for undetectable same-value ownership replacement.
